name: Diagnostics & Genomics
targetResearchers: Genomicists, bioinformaticians, clinical pathologists, and assay-development scientists working on sequencing, liquid biopsy, and single-cell methods
useCases: Assay validation with academic medical centers
description: The diagnostics and genomics industry depends on academic medical centers and university genomics labs to validate assays, supply clinical cohorts, and pioneer methods like single-cell and spatial sequencing. Companies recruit bioinformaticians and genomics PhDs and engage academic key opinion leaders to drive clinical adoption of new tests. Biobank access and sponsored biomarker research with university pathology departments are central to bringing diagnostics to market.
